name: block-signup
title: Sign-up block
description: Name, email and password account form with validation messages.
a11y: A section named by its title; the form is named by the same heading.
Invalid submits show a role=alert summary whose links move focus to each field, and each field gets aria-invalid and an error message.
The password hint states the minimum length; autocomplete hints are set.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading of the form. Default "Create your account".

props.name: description
props.description: Optional muted line under the heading.

props.name: submitLabel
props.description: Text of the submit button. Default "Create account".

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called with the values once they pass validation.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner on the submit button while you sign in.

props.name: footer
props.description: Links under the form: forgot password, create an account.

props.name: messages
props.type: Partial<{ name: string; email: string; emailInvalid: string; password: string; passwordShort: string; }>
props.description: Replace the validation messages (translate them, or change the tone).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Outline level of the title, 1 to 3. Default 1 because a signup page is usually the page's h1.

usage: import {BlockSignup, Link} from '@monoline/react'; Already have an account? Sign in} />
